summary: BPGC Acquisition Corp. (a blank-check SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting termination of its merger agreement with iRocket Technologies. The Merger Agreement, originally entered July 22, 2025 and amended multiple times, was terminated by iRocket on April 14, 2026, because the transaction was not completed by the March 16, 2026 outside date. After termination, the parties discussed reinstatement for about eight weeks but failed to agree on terms. No termination fee is disclosed. The SPAC now must find a new target, liquidate, or pursue other strategic alternatives. Watch for any new business combination or liquidation vote.
